prompt:

Glossy cartoon mobile-game icon style: a thick, even dark brown outline; vibrant, saturated colors; smooth gel-like glossy surfaces with soft multi-tone gradient shading and soft clean highlights, with no sparkles, stars or glints anywhere; simple and clean. Cute and friendly look. Drawn large with nothing cropped or hidden, as ONE single object only. Canvas: a square 1:1; the object fills most of the canvas. One plain solid white background, with no labels, no ground shadow and nothing else in the image. No text and no numbers.
Keep the art simple and readable at small mobile-game icon sizes. Broad smooth shapes, clean even dark-brown outlines, only 2 or 3 soft shading tones per surface and one or two simple highlights. NO fine texture, intricate veins, realistic surface detail, excessive reflections or ornamental detail. A polished cute cartoon, not a highly rendered illustration. Keep the requested composition and isolated pieces.
Use just a few broad tissue-paper layers with short simple fringe, no intricate shredded paper texture.
